key_insight: Among WC-10Co-4Cr thermal-sprayed coatings, HVOF and HVAF deliver the best overall wear performance, while HVAF gives the strongest corrosion resistance.
engineering_relevance: This study helps select spray processes for stainless-steel surfaces where high hardness, low wear, and corrosion protection are needed in demanding mechanical service.
method: Prepared WC-10Co-4Cr coatings on 304 stainless steel using APS, DS, HVOF, and HVAF.
Compared microstructure, Vickers hardness, friction/wear, and electrochemical corrosion behavior.
Ranked process performance by wear resistance and corrosion resistance.
evidence_signal: Measured hardness increased from APS to HVAF/HVOF (771.4 to 1166.2 HV), wear rate dropped sharply versus 304 stainless steel, and HVAF showed the best corrosion metrics (Ecorr -0.37 VSCE, Icorr 1.75 μA/cm², R 20438.5 Ω).
watch_item: Performance rankings are process-specific and may shift with spray parameters, substrate condition, and service environment, so direct transfer to other applications should be validated experimentally.
paper_title: Microstructure, Wear and Corrosion Resistances of Atmospheric Plasma, Detonation, High Velocity Oxy-fuel and High Velocity Air-fuel Sprayed WC-10Co-4Cr Cemented Carbide Coatings
